claim: RZX frames Fuse writes for an interrupt held off are near-empty (about 20 T), so weigh short frames by their T-states rather than counting whole frames.

evidence.text: Fuse writes a roughly 20 T frame when an interrupt delayed by DI lands, so a frame count runs ahead; weigh short frames by their T.
